payload.question: What is a Trojan horse?

answers.B: Software that appears to be one thing but has unexpected malicious functionality
answers.C: Software designed to break security by exploiting security loopholes
answers.D: Malware that relies on someone or something else to propagate from one system to another

correct_answer.B: Software that appears to be one thing but has unexpected malicious functionality
correct_answer.C: Software designed to break security by exploiting security loopholes
correct_answer.D: Malware that relies on someone or something else to propagate from one system to another

payload.question: What type of virus is installed when the code it is attached to is loaded and executed?

answers.B: It pretends to be something else
